name: Focus Starter
subtitle: 30 capsules
tagline: The smallest sensible way to find out if this works for you.
shortDesc: A two-week trial size of our daily focus formula, for people who would rather test something than commit to it.
longDesc: Nootropics are individual. What sharpens one person's afternoon does nothing for the next, and the only way to find out which you are is to run the experiment on yourself for a couple of weeks.
Focus Starter exists so that experiment costs you the price of a few coffees. Fifteen servings, the same formula as the full-size bottle, no subscription attached.

benefits.title: Formulated for daily focus
benefits.text: Designed to support attention and mental clarity during long work sessions.

benefits.title: A real trial length
benefits.text: Fifteen servings — long enough to notice a pattern rather than a single good day.

benefits.title: No commitment
benefits.text: One-time purchase. Subscribe later only if it earns it.

usage: Take 2 capsules in the morning with water. Do not exceed the labelled serving.
whoFor: First-time buyers who want to test the category before spending real money.

faq.q: How long before I notice anything?
faq.a: Effects vary between individuals, and some people notice nothing at all. Give it the full fifteen servings before deciding, and pay attention to sleep and caffeine as confounders.

faq.q: Can I take it with coffee?
faq.a: Many people do, but stack stimulants carefully and start with less caffeine than usual on your first few days.

name: Energy & Focus Stack
subtitle: 12-pack
tagline: For the twelve days a month that actually demand it.
shortDesc: A stimulant-forward energy and focus formula in single-serve sachets, built for demanding days rather than daily use.
longDesc: Some days need more than a baseline. This is the formula for those: an energy and focus blend in single-serve sachets, so the dose is fixed and the packet count tells you honestly how often you are reaching for it.
Twelve servings is deliberate. If you are finishing a pack a week, the problem is your sleep, not your supplement.

benefits.title: Single-serve accuracy
benefits.text: Pre-measured sachets — no scoop, no guessing, no creeping dose.

benefits.title: Built for peak days
benefits.text: Formulated for deadlines, early starts and long drives rather than everyday background use.

benefits.title: Travels flat
benefits.text: Sachets fit a laptop sleeve, a glovebox or a jacket pocket.

usage: Mix one sachet into 300–400 ml of cold water. Use on demanding days only. Avoid within six hours of bedtime.
whoFor: People with occasional high-demand days who do not want a daily stimulant habit.

faq.q: Can I take this every day?
faq.a: We do not recommend it. Stimulant tolerance builds quickly, and the value of this formula depends on it staying occasional.

faq.q: How much caffeine is in it?
faq.a: The exact amount is printed on the sachet. Count it against your daily total, including coffee.

name: Day & Night Brain Bundle
subtitle: Focus + sleep support
shortDesc: A daytime focus formula paired with an evening wind-down formula, because the two problems are the same problem.
longDesc: Almost everyone shopping for a focus supplement is really shopping for the consequences of a bad night. Treating only the daytime half of that loop is how people end up escalating stimulants for months without getting anywhere.
This bundle covers both ends: a daytime formula for attention, and a non-sedating evening formula to support the wind-down. One month of each.

benefits.title: Addresses the actual loop
benefits.text: Daytime focus support paired with evening wind-down support.

benefits.title: Nothing habit-forming at night
benefits.text: The evening formula is not a sedative and contains no prescription sleep agents.

benefits.title: A full month of each
benefits.text: Thirty servings per side — enough to judge the routine, not just the product.

usage: Day formula with breakfast. Night formula 30–60 minutes before bed. Do not double up on the day formula late in the afternoon.
whoFor: Anyone whose focus problem starts at 11pm the night before.

faq.q: Can I buy the halves separately?
faq.a: Not currently — the bundle price is the reason it exists. Individual SKUs are on the roadmap.

faq.q: Will the night formula make me groggy?
faq.a: It is not sedating and contains no melatonin, so morning grogginess is uncommon. Everyone responds differently, so try it first on a night without an early start.

name: Universal Brain Formula
subtitle: 60 capsules
tagline: One bottle, one month, no stack to manage.
shortDesc: A single broad-spectrum daily formula for people who want one bottle on the shelf instead of six.
longDesc: The usual nootropic path is six bottles, a spreadsheet and a slowly growing suspicion that none of it is doing anything. The alternative is one broad formula taken consistently for long enough to actually judge.
This is that bottle: a full month at two capsules a day, stimulant-free, designed to sit alongside coffee rather than compete with it.

benefits.title: One bottle instead of six
benefits.text: A broad daily formula rather than a stack you have to manage.

benefits.title: Stimulant-free
benefits.text: No added caffeine, so it does not interfere with your existing coffee habit or your evening.

benefits.title: A full month
benefits.text: 60 capsules at the labelled two-capsule serving.

usage: Take 2 capsules in the morning with food. Consistency matters more than timing.
whoFor: People who have tried single-ingredient nootropics and want one considered formula instead.

faq.a: No. It is designed to be stimulant-free so you control your own caffeine separately.

faq.q: Can I take it alongside the Energy & Focus Stack?
faq.a: Yes, on demanding days — but read both labels and count your total caffeine.

name: Black Label
subtitle: Premium daily formula
shortDesc: A higher-specification version of the daily formula, using premium raw materials and standardised extracts.
longDesc: Black Label is what the daily formula looks like without a cost ceiling: standardised extracts instead of raw powders, patented ingredient forms where they exist, and doses set by the research rather than by the margin.
It costs meaningfully more and it is not the right first purchase. Start on Focus Starter or the Universal Brain Formula, and move up only if the category is clearly doing something for you.

benefits.title: Standardised extracts
benefits.text: Actives specified by extract standardisation rather than raw plant weight.

benefits.title: Research-led amounts
benefits.text: Doses set to the levels used in published human trials where those exist.

benefits.title: Honest positioning
benefits.text: This is an upgrade, not a starting point. We will tell you that on the product page every time.

usage: Take 2 capsules in the morning with food.
whoFor: Returning customers who already know they respond to the category.

faq.q: Is it worth the jump from the standard formula?
faq.a: Only if the standard formula already works for you. If you noticed nothing on a full month of the Universal Brain Formula, a more expensive version of the same category is unlikely to change that.

faq.q: Can I alternate between the two?
faq.a: Yes. Some people run Black Label on heavy weeks and the standard formula otherwise.

name: Executive Function Blend
subtitle: Comprehensive formula
tagline: The comprehensive end of the shelf.
shortDesc: A large multi-ingredient formula for people who want breadth in one product rather than a self-assembled stack.
longDesc: This is the widest formula we carry — a long ingredient list at a seven-capsule serving, aimed at people who would otherwise be buying eight separate bottles and taking them inconsistently.

Breadth has a cost, and not only in money: with this many actives, it is genuinely hard to attribute an effect to any single ingredient. If you want to know what works for you specifically, work up from the simpler formulas instead.

benefits.title: Breadth in one product
benefits.text: Replaces a self-assembled multi-bottle stack with a single serving.

benefits.title: Full serving, not a token dose
benefits.text: A seven-capsule serving because the ingredient list does not fit in two.

benefits.title: Straight talk on attribution
benefits.text: With this many actives you will not learn which one matters. We would rather say so than pretend otherwise.

usage: Take 7 capsules in the morning on an empty stomach, or split across breakfast and mid-morning. Many people run five days on, two days off.
whoFor: Experienced buyers who have already worked out that they respond, and want coverage rather than clarity.

faq.q: Seven capsules is a lot. Can I take fewer?
faq.a: You can take a partial serving, but then you are taking a partial dose of everything, including the ingredients that were the reason you bought it.
Five days on, two off is a common pattern with formulas this broad. It is convention rather than a documented requirement.

name: Complete Day & Night Stack
subtitle: 240 capsules
tagline: Two months of the whole routine.
shortDesc: A two-month supply of the day and night formulas together, at the lowest cost per day we offer.
longDesc: Sixty days of both formulas. This is the size to buy once you already know the routine suits you, because two months in one purchase is only good value if you are going to finish it.
Cost per day is the lowest on the shelf. Cost per mistake, if the category turns out not to work for you, is the highest — which is why Focus Starter exists.

benefits.title: Lowest cost per day
benefits.text: Two months of both formulas in a single purchase.

benefits.title: The full routine
benefits.text: Day and night formulas together, matched to the same end date.

benefits.title: Fewer reorders
benefits.text: One delivery every two months instead of four.

usage: 2 day capsules with breakfast, 2 night capsules 30–60 minutes before bed.
whoFor: Repeat customers who have finished at least one month and want to stop reordering so often.

faq.q: Will it stay good for two months?
faq.a: Yes — check the printed expiry, which will be well beyond the supply period. Store both bottles somewhere cool and dry.

faq.q: Is this a better deal than subscribing?
faq.a: Subscribe & Save applies on top, so the cheapest per-day option is this size on subscription.

name: Executive 2-Bottle Supply
subtitle: Extended supply bundle
tagline: Two bottles of the Executive Function Blend.
shortDesc: An extended supply of the comprehensive formula for people who have settled on it and want to stop reordering.
longDesc: Two bottles of the Executive Function Blend, bought together. There is nothing clever about this SKU: it is the same product in a quantity that makes sense once you have decided.
Do not start here. Buy one bottle first, finish it, then decide whether the second one is worth $396 of shelf space.

benefits.title: Roughly three months of supply
benefits.text: Two bottles at the standard seven-capsule serving.

benefits.title: One decision, one delivery
benefits.text: Fewer reorders, one renewal date.

benefits.title: Same formula
benefits.text: Identical to the single bottle — no reformulation, no bulk-grade substitution.

usage: As per the single bottle: 7 capsules in the morning, or split across the morning.
whoFor: Committed users of the Executive Function Blend.

faq.q: Can I split this with someone?
faq.a: Yes — they are two sealed bottles.

faq.q: What is the return position on a bulk bundle?
faq.a: The same as everything else: 60 days, opened or unopened. See Shipping & Returns.

name: Ultimate 4-Bottle Supply
subtitle: Long-supply bundle
tagline: The largest quantity we will sell you.
shortDesc: Four bottles of the Executive Function Blend — roughly six months, for people who are certain.
longDesc: This is the top of the range and the only honest thing to say about it is that most people should not buy it. Six months of anything is a bet on a version of yourself six months from now.
If you are still here: four sealed bottles, same formula, one delivery, and the same 60-day return window as every other order.

benefits.title: Roughly six months
benefits.text: Four bottles at the standard serving.

benefits.title: Sealed bottles
benefits.text: Opened one at a time, so the rest keep to their printed expiry.

benefits.title: The 60-day window still applies
benefits.text: Buying big does not shorten your return rights.

usage: As per the single bottle. Open one bottle at a time and keep the rest sealed and cool.
whoFor: Long-term users who have already bought this formula more than once.

faq.q: Should I really buy six months at once?
faq.a: Probably not, unless you have already finished several bottles. The 2-bottle supply is the sensible ceiling for most people.

faq.q: Will all four bottles have the same expiry?
faq.a: They ship from the same lot wherever stock allows, so expiries will usually match. Check the printed dates on arrival.
